Canvas target 1792 x 2032, each panel 1792x1008 plus separator. These are separate full scenes, not one scene divided. Painterly realistic AAA fantasy game environment concept art, highly polished stone/material detail, readable shapes, strong atmospheric depth. Eye-level environment view, lower 40% of EACH panel a broad empty walkable foreground to place interactive sprites later. No people, no monsters, no treasure chests or containers baked into scenery, no readable writing, no watermark. Match dark elegant fantasy with gold inlays, not military or photoreal photography. A powerful destination, clearly different from outerroad but same culture. Rich composition, avoid a giant distracting foreground focal object.

objects:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, a precise 6 COLUMN by 3 ROW rectangular grid of EXACTLY 18 separate fantasy objects. Landscape canvas with evenly sized cells, perfectly aligned centers. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with clear alpha between objects. No text, no cell borders, no UI, no shadows outside objects, no pedestal or floor. Each object occupies about 70% of its cell with at least 12% clear padding on all sides; no object touches or overlaps a neighbor. Highly polished hand-painted realistic fantasy RPG inventory art, antique gilded metal, readable silhouette and jewel highlights, crisp 3/4 view. Match elegant dark fantasy world 'Void Rift'. First row contains SIX searchable containers, bigger chunky objects. Rows two and three contain TWELVE valuable collectible loot items. Strict reading order LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
ROW1: (1) heavy rectangular blackened brass royal military coffer with golden sun crest, CLOSED; (2) round lidded obsidian-and-bronze ember urn with faint orange cracks, CLOSED; (3) small ancient ROOT HOLLOW container, a chunky twisted stump with an oval dark opening and ivy, no floor; (4) large teal bioluminescent fungal pod container, curled leaves around a glowing CLOSED seed-pod; (5) violet stone astral secret casket with golden orbit-ring clasp, CLOSED; (6) tall slender dark-blue prayer cabinet with arched gold door and a small star crest, CLOSED.
ROW2: (1) weathered bronze cinder medal on a short dark-red ribbon; (2) molten-gold regal seal with garnet handle; (3) faceted black obsidian ceremonial chalice with a restrained gold rim; (4) broken radiant sun crown of ancient gilded bronze with one warm amber stone; (5) large amber translucent magical acorn, green bronze cap; (6) tiny faceted clear vial shaped like a glowing moon-dew drop with a silver leaf cap.
ROW3: (1) emerald-patterned ancient stone covenant tablet, a palm-sized angular slate bound in roots; (2) luminous ancient-tree heart flower bud with layered green petals around golden living core; (3) pocket star-compass with elegant golden needle on midnight-blue enamel disk; (4) sharp violet-blue meteor prism shard with luminous inner star; (5) ornate round golden orbital lens with crystalline blue glass and a single ring around it; (6) small celestial clockwork instrument, intricate golden spherical astrolabe surrounding a dark violet hourglass core.
Keep the six container silhouettes immediately distinguishable: coffer, urn, stump hollow, fungal pod, casket, tall cabinet. Keep all twelve loot objects individually distinct. Natural material colors, carefully controlled highlights, no neon glow smears, no background color, no cast scene shadows. Every individual item must be a complete isolated object.
objects_spacing_revision: Edit this fantasy object sprite atlas only to correct spacing and clipping. Preserve all EXACT 18 object identities, reading order, beautiful detailed painterly styling and colors. Arrange them as a mathematically even SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid on a TRUE TRANSPARENT canvas. Every object must be entirely within its own equal cell, with wide transparent margins at least 15% of cell width on left and right and 12% of cell height top and bottom. Add a clear transparent outer margin around whole atlas, especially top and bottom. Shrink objects enough that their complete silhouettes fit comfortably. Reconstruct any tips touching canvas edges. NO touching canvas edges or neighboring objects. No colored background, labels, text, frame or cell dividers. Keep actual alpha transparency. These will be cut by equal rectangular cells, so clear gutters and regular cell centers are essential. Exact order unchanged.
